title: Untitled: O YOU unwise and unlearned! teach…
text: O YOU unwise and unlearned! teach us first what God is that you may be believed in accusing me of impiety; tell us where God is. Is he shut up within the walls of temples? is this your piety to place God in the dark, or to make him a stony god? O you unskilful! know ye not that God is not made with hands, and hath no basis or fulcrum to stand upon, nor can be inclosed within the walls of any temple; the whole world, variegated with plants, animals, and stars, being his temple?—HERACLITUS, 500 в. с.
